_description: Innate unit effects (docs/en/training/units.md, Innate effects): every attribute and passive or game-fired ability of the units in config/nn/units.json, from the game's database. Written by python -m tools.nn.effects; the simulator (tools/nn/sim/effects.py) lays on the `modelled` ones, the network (tools/nn/model/effects.py) sees each by `order` (append-only).

_fields.kind: attribute (a rule flag of the engine), passive (on while its conditions hold), timed (fired by the game itself, active_s then recharge_s)
_fields.rules: rule flags it sets (attributes; ability attribute effects)
_fields.stats: the ability passport's stat effects: stat, how (add / mult), value, on (self, friends within range_m), sim (the simulator's stat; null: not modelled)
_fields.needs: predicates that must hold for it to be on (the database's recharge contexts of a passive)
_fields.off_when: predicates that hold it off (the database's auto-deactivate flags)
_fields.timed: a timed passive: active_s, recharge_s, fires_when (the recharge contexts)
_fields.predicates: the conditions the simulator evaluates: out_of_melee = out of melee, in_melee = in melee, losing_melee = losing its melee, morale_below_half = morale below half of leadership, not_wavering = steady (not wavering or routing), hp_below_half = health below 50 % of the start, hp_below_quarter = health below 25 % (db flag -> predicate: out_of_melee -> out_of_melee, engaged_in_melee -> in_melee, losing_melee_combat -> losing_melee, morale_is_lower_than_half_of_base_morale -> morale_below_half, morale_is_higher_than_wavering -> not_wavering, health_below_50%_base -> hp_below_half, health_below_25% -> hp_below_quarter)

_missing.effect bundles: effect_bundles / effect_bonus_value_*: campaign effects (skills, techs, the contexts of battle_context_unit_attribute_junctions such as causes_fear vs a culture); custom battles have none
_missing.attribute numbers: unit_attributes_tables holds the keys only: an attribute's rule and numbers are the engine's (_kv tables, game_rules.json) and the knowledge base's (ATTRIBUTES in tools/nn/effects.py)
_missing.stubborn, hatred: not in the WH3 database as unit attributes or passive abilities (WH2 had them)
_missing.phase flags: special_ability_phases (unbreakable, cant_move, ... per phase) is not decoded: the phases of our passives carry their effects in the stat and attribute tables

charge_defense_vs_large.name: Charge Defence vs. Large
charge_defense_vs_large.does: braced, cancels the charge bonus of large chargers from the front
charge_defense_vs_large.why: no large units in our pools (no cavalry or monsters yet)

charge_reflection.name: Charge Reflection
charge_reflection.does: braced, reflects a frontal charge (_kv_rules charge_reflect_damage_multiplier 2, charge_reflect_min_charge_factor_threshold 0.7)
charge_reflection.sim: braced (slower than melee.braced_speed at contact), meets a frontal infantry charge as a charge (battle.py)

encourages.name: Encourage
encourages.does: +4 leadership to friends nearby (_kv_morale general_aura_radius 70 m, general_inspire_effect_amount_max 4; not stacking with the lord's aura since 5.3)
encourages.sim: the lord's aura: +4 morale points to friends within 70 m, fading to 0 at 105 m (battle.py)

expendable.name: Expendable
expendable.does: its rout scares only other expendable units (routing_friends_effect_weighting -3 each)
expendable.sim: its rout does not count among the routing friends of others (battle.py)

guerrilla_deploy.name: Vanguard Deployment
guerrilla_deploy.does: may deploy outside the deployment zone, not in the enemy's
guerrilla_deploy.why: deployment comes from the army generator (tools/nn/armies/place.py)

hide_forest.name: Hide (forest)
hide_forest.why: the simulator's maps have no woods and no hiding

unbreakable.name: Unbreakable
unbreakable.does: never loses leadership, never routs (also not when the army is destroyed)
unbreakable.sim: morale points never below leadership: never wavers or routs (morale.py)

wh2_main_unit_passive_scurry_away.name: Scurry Away
wh2_main_unit_passive_scurry_away.when: off while steady (not wavering or routing)
wh2_main_unit_passive_scurry_away.sim: scalar_speed mult 1.1 (off while steady (not wavering or routing))

wh2_main_unit_passive_strength_in_number.name: Strength In Numbers
wh2_main_unit_passive_strength_in_number.when: off while health below 50 % of the start
wh2_main_unit_passive_strength_in_number.sim: scalar_speed mult 0.9; stat_melee_defence add 8; stat_morale add 6 (off while health below 50 % of the start)

wh3_main_unit_passive_single_entity.name: Single Entity
wh3_main_unit_passive_single_entity.sim: scalar_speed mult 0.9; stat_melee_damage_ap mult 0.8; stat_melee_damage_base mult 0.8 (while health below 25 %)

wh_dlc04_unit_passive_strength_of_the_pe.name: Strength Of The Penitent
wh_dlc04_unit_passive_strength_of_the_pe.when: the game fires it when losing its melee: 20 s, ready again 3 s after; off while out of melee
wh_dlc04_unit_passive_strength_of_the_pe.source: db: unit_special_abilities, special_ability_phase_stat_effects, special_ability_to_auto_deactivate_flags, special_ability_to_recharge_contexts (wh_dlc04_unit_passive_strength_of_the_penitent); config/nn/abilities.json
wh_dlc04_unit_passive_strength_of_the_pe.sim: stat_melee_defence add 14; stat_resistance_physical add 15 (the game fires it when losing its melee: 20 s, ready again 3 s after; off while out of melee)

wh_main_unit_passive_frenzy.name: Frenzy
wh_main_unit_passive_frenzy.when: off while morale below half of leadership
wh_main_unit_passive_frenzy.source: db: unit_special_abilities, special_ability_phase_stat_effects, special_ability_phase_attribute_effects, special_ability_to_auto_deactivate_flags (wh_main_unit_passive_frenzy); config/nn/abilities.json
wh_main_unit_passive_frenzy.sim: stat_charge_bonus mult 1.1; stat_melee_attack add 10; stat_melee_damage_ap mult 1.1; stat_melee_damage_base mult 1.1 (off while morale below half of leadership)
wh_main_unit_passive_frenzy.why: rules with nothing to act on: immune_to_psychology
